verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents an OAuth-secured API that exposes ledger data such as bank transactions, and a dashboard with real-time cashflow and a 90-day projection. However, nothing in the evidence shows a first-party agent or AI assistant that answers affordability questions from live ledger data. The API is only a developer building block that a user could wire to their own agent, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: OAuth 2.0 allows FreeAgent users to authorise third party apps to access their data without sharing their FreeAgent login details.
Track cashflow in real time on your dashboard and see your 90-day projection.
